task: A school wants to organise a class trip to a zoo. Weigh the idea.

en.title: Speed: three analyses, one after another
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
Three analysts, each waiting for the one before.

**What it teaches**

A chain waits for every step; the same analyses take about three times as long as side by side.

cs.title: Rychlost: tři rozbory za sebou
cs.author: Agent Atlas Academy
cs.description:
Tři analytici, každý čeká na toho před sebou.

**Čemu se naučíte**

Řetěz čeká na každý krok; stejné rozbory trvají asi třikrát déle než vedle sebe.

teaches.en: A chain waits for every step; the same analyses take about three times as long as side by side.
